## ⚡ Improved

- **ParleyPort no longer names the apps that use it.** The startup banner and the Docker Hub description call it a relay for apps that pair their instances. The protocol stays as it is, so every client connects exactly as before.

## 🐛 Fixed

- **The default relay address in the code is parleyport.halleluja.design**, the name the apps dial. The old name relay.halleluja.design keeps answering.
